Name: Birthday Rolodex - Show All The Birthdays
Author: ichortower
Description:
[size=4]Do you have a lot of modded NPCs in your game? Then they probably have overlapping birthdays, and you have probably seen on the calendar that only one NPC's sprite is displayed on the date. Well, this mod addresses that problem by displaying all of them in a rotating queue.

When you mouseover each date, the lineup of NPC images will start automatically rotating. You can also left-click or scroll your mouse wheel to rotate them manually, which will pause the automatic rotation for a time.

This mod has no other effects and won't meaningfully change your gameplay, but I think it makes looking at the calendar a bit nicer.

[url=https://github.com/ichortower/BirthdayRolodex]Source Code[/url]

[size=6][b][u]Configuration[/u][/b][/size]

You can tweak most of this mod's behavior via its config. As usual, use of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is recommended.

[b][color=#6376bf]CycleTime[/color][/b]: (integer, minimum 500) how long, in milliseconds, to wait between each movement when automatically rotating the queue. [i]Default: 1000[/i].
[b][color=#6376bf]PauseTime[/color][/b]: (integer, minimum 1000) how long, in milliseconds, to wait after the player manually rotates the queue before restarting the automatic rotation. [i]Default: 4000[/i].
[b][color=#6376bf]StaggerDistance[/color][/b]: (integer, 4-16) how far, in screen pixels, each additional icon is offset from the main draw position. [i]Default: 12[/i].
[b][color=#6376bf]QueueBrightness[/color][/b]: (integer, 0-255) how brightly each additional icon is drawn. [i]Default: 108[/i].
[b][color=#6376bf]CycleSoundVolume[/color][/b]: (float, 0.0-1.0) How loudly, relative to normal SFX volume, to play the page sound effect when manually rotating the queue. Set to 0 to disable the sound. [i]Default: 0.33[/i].
[b][color=#6376bf]AlwaysCycle[/color][/b]: (boolean) Whether to automatically rotate the queue even when not hovering over the date. [i]Default: false[/i].
[b][color=#6376bf]InvertScrollDirection[/color][/b]: (boolean) Whether to flip the default mapping of scroll wheel directions to queue rotation directions. [i]Default: false[/i].

[size=6][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b][/size]

No known conflicts at this time. This mod doesn't ship any of its own assets, so it should seamlessly work with any interface mods, character sprite edits, etc.

This mod isn't specifically written for birthdays, and should work with any day event that defines its own texture, which is how birthdays are set up to behave on the calendar. No other day events do this, to my knowledge.
